title: DOST-SEI Junior Level Science Scholarships (JLSS)
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Scholarship for regular second-year college students in DOST-SEI priority S&T courses at identified universities; covers third year onward including RA 7687 RA 10612 and Merit tracks.
benefit_summary: Same privilege package as undergraduate S&T scholars per official JLSS portal
evidence_snippet: JLSS open to REGULAR second-year college students in priority S&T courses; application period April 21-May 23, 2025; qualifying exam July 27, 2025

title: Accelerated Science and Technology Human Resource Development Program (ASTHRDP)
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: MS and PhD scholarships in priority S&T fields through NSC member universities.
benefit_summary: Graduate scholarship privileges per ASTHRDP brochure; deadlines vary by consortium university
evidence_snippet: ASTHRDP listed as unified MS/PhD human resource program with separate portal asthrdp.science-scholarships.ph

title: Engineering Research and Development for Technology (ERDT)
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Master's and doctorate degrees in engineering fields for high-impact research and qualification upgrade.
benefit_summary: Graduate engineering scholarship through ERDT consortium universities
evidence_snippet: ERDT aims to provide master's and doctorate degrees in various engineering fields

title: Capacity Building Program in Science and Mathematics Education (CBPSME)
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Master's and doctoral degrees in Science and Mathematics Education for DOST scholar-graduates TEI faculty and qualified educators.
benefit_summary: Graduate scholarships in science and mathematics education
evidence_snippet: CBPSME scholarships for pursuit of Master's and Doctoral degrees in Science and Mathematics Education

title: DOST-SEI Merit Scholarship (undergraduate track)
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Merit track (RA 2067) for students with high aptitude in science and mathematics; no income ceiling distinct from RA 7687 track.
benefit_summary: Same privileges as S&T Undergraduate Scholarship package
evidence_snippet: DOST-SEI Merit Scholarship Program awarded to students with high aptitude in science and mathematics

title: DOST-SEI RA 7687 Scholarship (undergraduate track)
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Need-based track under RA 7687 for talented students whose family socio-economic status does not exceed set cut-off indicators.
benefit_summary: Same privileges as S&T Undergraduate Scholarship package
evidence_snippet: RA 7687 provides scholarships to talented and deserving students whose families' socio-economic status does not exceed set cut-off values
